name: Grave Digger

specialAbility.name: Graveyard Smash
specialAbility.description: Grave Digger channels the power of a thousand tombstones to double its smash damage for one devastating hit!

lore: Born in a spooky graveyard on a stormy night, Grave Digger rose from the mud with glowing green flames and a hunger for crushing everything in its path! They say if you listen closely, you can hear ghostly cheering every time it lands a massive jump. No truck in history has won more fans or smashed more cars!
